scope: conditional historical development response, not accepted physical calibration or accuracy evaluation
strict_physical_branch: BLOCKED: historical physical gyro axis/sign, true sampling clocks/delays and odom-origin correspondence unverified
clock_hypothesis: uncorrected identity of recorded header epochs as in frozen legacy policy; no inferred delay
angular_numeric_source: A exact frozen config.template.json at A_commit; no endpoint-based fit or selection
comparison: all output, all estimate-valid, explicit fallbacks, common estimate-valid; no RMSE/ATE or gain percentage
marginal_readback: every F1-F3 marginalization, independent finite differences and Schur projection; no online factor/Jacobian imports
failed_run_policy: preserve partial directory; no automatic rerun or parameter change
